components.name: RoboForge SDK
components.summary: The Python SDK: one API for simulators, renderers, ROS 2, MAVLink and controllers. Ships with the IDE.

components.name: ROS 1 Noetic
components.summary: ROS 1 desktop via RoboStack. Runs on any modern distro, no Ubuntu 20.04 needed.

components.name: ROS 2 Humble
components.summary: ROS 2 Humble desktop (LTS) via RoboStack.

components.name: ROS 2 Jazzy
components.summary: ROS 2 Jazzy desktop (LTS) via RoboStack.

components.name: ROS 2 Kilted
components.summary: ROS 2 Kilted desktop via RoboStack.

components.name: ROS 2 Lyrical
components.summary: ROS 2 Lyrical desktop via RoboStack.

components.name: ROS 2 Rolling
components.summary: ROS 2 Rolling desktop via RoboStack.

components.name: PX4 Autopilot 1.16
components.summary: PX4 source tree for SITL and firmware work.
components.notes: SITL with Gazebo is built against the Gazebo in the same environment. Building PX4's gz plugins against conda-forge Gazebo has not been validated by RoboForge; if it fails, fall back to PX4's Tools/setup/ubuntu.sh on the host.

components.name: PX4 Autopilot 1.15
components.summary: Previous PX4 release, installable side by side with 1.16.

components.name: Micro XRCE-DDS Agent
components.summary: Bridge between PX4 uORB topics and ROS 2 (/fmu/in, /fmu/out).

components.name: MAVSDK-Python
components.summary: MAVLink SDK for any MAVSDK-compatible vehicle (PX4, ArduPilot). Works with or without ROS.

components.name: pymavlink
components.summary: MAVLink for Python: what the RoboForge SDK's MAVLink link speaks (vehicle emulation, client, PX4-in-the-loop).

components.name: MoveIt
components.summary: Motion planning for manipulators, with the Panda demo configuration.
components.notes: Package availability on RoboStack varies by distro.

components.name: Nav2
components.summary: ROS 2 navigation stack with nav2_bringup and the TurtleBot3 simulation.
components.notes: Package availability on RoboStack varies by distro.

components.name: Gazebo (gz-sim)
components.summary: Gazebo simulator. In a ROS environment it comes through ros_gz so the versions match.

components.name: MuJoCo
components.summary: MuJoCo physics with Python bindings and the passive viewer.

components.name: Isaac Sim 5.1
components.summary: NVIDIA Isaac Sim pip packages in a dedicated environment.
components.notes: Needs an RTX GPU and GLIBC 2.35+. Lives in its own environment because Isaac Sim pins its dependency set; it talks to your ROS environment over DDS. You accept the NVIDIA EULA on first launch.

components.name: Isaac Lab
components.summary: Robot learning framework on Isaac Sim, installed into the Isaac environment.

components.name: PyTorch (CUDA 12.8)
components.summary: PyTorch and torchvision wheels built for CUDA 12.8.

components.name: PyTorch (CPU)
components.summary: CPU-only PyTorch and torchvision.

components.name: PyTorch3D
components.summary: Differentiable rendering and 3D ops, built from source against the installed PyTorch.
components.notes: Compiles from source (10-20 min). A GPU build needs the CUDA toolkit (nvcc) visible in the environment.

components.name: gsplat
components.summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting rasterisation for PyTorch.
components.notes: May compile its CUDA kernels on first import if no prebuilt wheel matches your PyTorch/CUDA pair.

components.name: Open3D
components.summary: Point cloud and mesh processing, visualisation.

components.name: slam_toolbox
components.summary: 2D lidar SLAM for ROS 2.
components.notes: Package availability on RoboStack varies by distro.

components.name: MonoGS (Gaussian Splatting SLAM)
components.summary: Source checkout of MonoGS for monocular/RGB-D Gaussian SLAM research.
components.notes: Checked out only. Its own Python requirements are not installed automatically.

components.name: SplaTAM
components.summary: Source checkout of SplaTAM dense RGB-D Gaussian SLAM.
components.notes: Checked out only. Its own Python requirements are not installed automatically.

components.name: ORB-SLAM3
components.summary: Source checkout of ORB-SLAM3 (visual / visual-inertial SLAM).
components.notes: Checked out only. Build with its build.sh (needs Pangolin, OpenCV, Eigen).
